name: KeyQuest
summary: A browser-based typing adventure for children: learn touch typing across ten Typing Academy lessons, race timed waves in Word Rush, and battle King Typo on the five-stage Starwood Trail.

features.title: Typing Academy (10 lessons)
features.description: Guided touch-typing curriculum from Home Row Left and Right through Top Row, Bottom Row, Shift capitals, numbers, punctuation, and the Final Exam, with an interactive color-coded keyboard.

features.title: Word Rush arcade mode
features.description: A 60-second wave survival mode with escalating word waves, streak combo multipliers, and a three-heart life counter.

features.title: Starwood Trail adventure
features.description: A five-stage quest across Sunny Forest, Crystal Cave, Misty Bridge, Fire Mountain, and Typo Castle against King Typo, where completed words power hero attacks.

features.title: XP levels, stars & Trophy Shelf
features.description: Earn 1 to 3 stars per lesson from WPM and accuracy targets, gain XP across every mode, and unlock 12 Trophy Shelf achievements.

features.title: Local browser storage & Web Audio
features.description: All progress is saved locally in the browser with no sign-up or external tracking, paired with synthesized Web Audio sound effects and a header mute toggle.

contextNote: KeyQuest was developed with participation in the Stripe Eindhoven Community hackathon, associated with One Horizon.
